title: Nucleic Acid Purification and Cloning Protocol
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Transfer assembly liquid to Mix‑Go
steps.instruction: Using a 20 µL pipette, dispense 5 µL of assembly‑plate liquid from slot 3 into the corresponding well of the Mix‑and‑Go plate in slot 1 for each sample.

steps.title: Gentle mixing after each transfer
steps.instruction: After each 5 µL addition, aspirate and dispense the liquid three times, then blow out the tip and return the tip to the tip rack in slot 4.

steps.title: Optional heat‑shock treatment
steps.instruction: If the “Heat Shock” parameter is set to Yes, raise the temperature module under slot 1 to 42 °C, hold for 40 seconds, then return the module to 4 °C.

steps.title: Incubate before agar loading
steps.instruction: Allow the Mix‑and‑Go plate to sit at 4 °C for 30 minutes before proceeding to agar‑plate distribution.

steps.title: Distribute mixture onto agar plates
steps.instruction: According to the “24 or 96 Distributions per Plate” and “Volume to Distribute on Agar” parameters, dispense the specified volume from slot 1 into the agar plates positioned in slots 5‑8 (four 24‑well layouts) or slot 9 (single 96‑well layout) at a height of ~5 mm above the agar surface. Use the single‑channel pipette for 24‑well distribution and the multi‑channel pipette for 96‑well distribution. Re‑use the same tip that handled the corresponding sample in steps 1–2.

steps.title: Optional deep‑well addition and mixing
steps.instruction: If “Add to Deep Well Plate” is Yes, dispense the “Volume to Add to Deep Well Plate” into the deep‑well plate for each sample, delivering the liquid 1 cm above the well bottom. Then perform a 20 µL mixing cycle ten times for each sample using the same tip as in steps 1, 2, and 5.

substeps.instruction: Dispense specified volume into deep‑well plate 1 cm above well bottom.
Mix 20 µL ten times for each sample.
